scope: Frequent front-panel actions with secondary menu access; refinement of the existing Windows Qt interface
method: Design review only: native Windows Qt Quick. Impeccable native review/audit principles adapted to desktop; web DOM detector and mobile platform rules do not apply.
design_authority: TechRequirement/design direction.md; existing semantic palette and working inspection pipeline

critique.design_specificity: The camera-dominant workspace, exact-cycle ROI, separate run/verdict/alarm states and restrained semantic colors are specific to the inspection instrument. The menu-only treatment of frequent review actions weakened this task-oriented hierarchy.

heuristics_before_polish.name: Visibility of system status
heuristics_before_polish.finding: Independent camera, monitoring, result and alarm states are visible.

heuristics_before_polish.name: Match system and real world
heuristics_before_polish.finding: Specimen, recipe, cycle and evidence terminology match the existing workflow.

heuristics_before_polish.name: User control and freedom
heuristics_before_polish.finding: At minimum height the shared result/control scroller can clip Start/Stop.

heuristics_before_polish.name: Consistency and standards
heuristics_before_polish.finding: Qt menus are familiar; direct recipe loading duplicates a menu handler.

heuristics_before_polish.name: Error prevention
heuristics_before_polish.finding: Explicit setup confirmation and action eligibility remain enforced by the existing controller.

heuristics_before_polish.name: Recognition rather than recall
heuristics_before_polish.finding: Offline inspection and results require remembering menu locations.

heuristics_before_polish.name: Flexibility and efficiency
heuristics_before_polish.finding: Frequent review actions require opening a menu each time.

heuristics_before_polish.name: Aesthetic and minimalist design
heuristics_before_polish.finding: Camera remains dominant; restrained themes and labeled groups aid scanning.

heuristics_before_polish.name: Error recovery
heuristics_before_polish.finding: Fault and coverage messages remain distinct from inspection verdicts.

heuristics_before_polish.name: Help and documentation
heuristics_before_polish.finding: About and empty-state guidance exist; complete in-app operator help is limited.

strengths: Camera preview remains the principal work area.
Semantic state colors are paired with text and separate operational meanings.
Desktop menus retain secondary actions without adding permanent tool panels.

priority_issues.issue: Start/Stop can scroll out of view at minimum height
priority_issues.impact: The primary monitoring controls require scrolling when the result card consumes the available height.
priority_issues.resolution: Pinned monitoring controls outside the result scroller; capped and scrollable verdict area.

priority_issues.impact: Operators need extra navigation and recall to open images or saved evidence.
priority_issues.resolution: Restored Offline inspection and Open results on the front panel; retained their menu entries.

priority_issues.issue: Recipe button and menu use separate handlers
priority_issues.impact: Duplicated action wiring can diverge as eligibility or behavior changes.
priority_issues.resolution: Recipe, offline and results shortcuts reuse their corresponding QML Actions.

critique.cognitive_load: Two direct review commands are exposed. Camera and specimen/recipe actions remain in separate task groups; training, diagnostics and preferences remain disclosed through menus.

personas.name: Alex, frequent operator
personas.red_flag: Repeated menu navigation to inspect an image or open saved results.

personas.name: Jordan, first-time operator
personas.red_flag: Available review tools are not visible until a menu is explored.

personas.name: Sam, keyboard/accessibility user
personas.red_flag: Scrolling can separate the monitoring controls from their operational context.

critique.emotional_journey: Keep preparation, Start/Stop and evidence retrieval predictable; do not imply inspection success through camera health or decorative color.
critique.questions: Questions skipped: the user explicitly selected the critique-polish-audit pipeline and asked to restore frequent front-panel actions.

other_changes: Visible focus and descriptive names for direct review buttons
Accessible descriptions for preview and exact-cycle ROI
No new colors, dependencies, animation or backend behavior
polish.priority_issue_status: All three critique priority issues addressed.

audit.platform_conformance: Pass for inspected paths: conventional Qt menus, direct operational controls, shared actions and content-area dialog sizing.

dimensions.name: Accessibility
dimensions.evidence: Real Tab traversal, visible focus, named controls/images and semantic contrast checks. Narrator and user text-scale acceptance remain unverified.

dimensions.name: Performance
dimensions.evidence: No new frame transport, workers, timers, effects or dependencies. Existing source/runtime bounds retained; no new endurance or latency benchmark performed.

dimensions.name: Appearance and theming
dimensions.evidence: Existing semantic tokens and shared controls; both themes rendered at three sizes; all 44 semantic text contrast cases included in validation.

dimensions.name: Desktop platform conformance
dimensions.evidence: Menus work by mouse and keyboard; direct offline and results actions dispatch correctly; Start/Stop remain beside preview without scrolling.

dimensions.name: Window adaptivity
dimensions.evidence: 960x640, 1280x800 and 1440x974 renders; active-job badge at minimum width; pinned controls and no clipped quick-action labels. OS DPI/font scaling remains station acceptance.

audit.rating: Good; bounded desktop verification, not accessibility or station certification

remaining_findings.issue: Fixed logical-pixel font and control sizing has no explicit user text-scale setting.
remaining_findings.impact: Large-text users may need additional accommodation despite Qt DPI scaling.
remaining_findings.recommendation: Exercise intended Windows DPI and text settings plus Narrator on the station; use impeccable adapt/harden if clipping or reading-order failures are observed.

verification.native_checks: Six main-window captures; both-theme menu mouse/keyboard dispatch; direct offline button; results dispatch intercepted to avoid Explorer; real Tab traversal; active-job narrow header; pinned controls and quick-button containment/text fit.
verification.hardware: No camera opened, actual-model fit performed or physical acceptance claimed.
